\begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{axis}[
        domain=0:5,
        samples=500,
        xmin=0, xmax=5, ymin=0, ymax=4.5,
        axis x line=middle,
        axis y line=middle,
        axis line style={line cap=round, very thick},
        tick style={line cap=round, very thick},
        every axis plot post/.append style={very thick, line cap=round},
        xlabel={$\nu$}, ylabel={},
        ylabel style={rotate=0, anchor=east},
        legend cell align=left,
        legend pos=north west,
        legend style={draw=black, fill=white, rounded corners}
    ]
        \draw[lightgray, dashed] (axis cs:1,0) -- (axis cs:1,4.5);
        \draw[lightgray, dashed] (axis cs:2,0) -- (axis cs:2,4.5);
        \draw[lightgray, dashed] (axis cs:3,0) -- (axis cs:3,4.5);
        \draw[lightgray, dashed] (axis cs:4,0) -- (axis cs:4,4.5);

        % 1) Chemical potential mu
        \addplot[myred] { floor(x) };
        \addlegendentry{$\mu(\nu)/U$}

        % 2) Ground‐state energy E0 piecewise quadratic
        \addplot[mygreen] { 0.5*(x-floor(x))*(ceil(x)*(ceil(x)-1))
            + 0.5*(ceil(x)-x)*(floor(x)*(floor(x)-1)) };
        \addlegendentry{$E_0/UN_{\text{sites}}$}
